title: Decrease (Contestant ver.)
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

We have a sequence of length $N$ consisting of non-negative integers. Consider performing the following operation on this sequence until the largest element in this sequence becomes $N-1$ or smaller.

- Determine the largest element in the sequence (if there is more than one, choose one). Decrease the value of this element by $N$, and increase each of the other elements by $1$.

It can be proved that the largest element in the sequence becomes $N-1$ or smaller after a finite number of operations.

You are given an integer $K$. Find an integer sequence $a_i$ such that the number of times we will perform the above operation is exactly $K$. It can be shown that there is always such a sequence under the constraints on input and output in this problem.

## Constraints

- $0 ≤ K ≤ 50 \times 10^{16}$

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
K
```

## Output

Print a solution in the following format:

```
N
a_1 a_2 ... a_N
```

Here, $2 ≤ N ≤ 50$ and $0 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^{16} + 1000$ must hold.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

有一个由非负整数构成的长度为 $N$ 的序列。重复进行以下操作，直到该序列中的最大元素变为 $N-1$ 或更小。

- 确定序列中的最大元素（如果有多个，任选一个）。将该元素的值减少 $N$，并将其他每个元素的值增加 $1$。

可以证明，经过有限次操作后，序列中的最大元素一定会变为 $N-1$ 或更小。

给定一个整数 $K$。请构造一个整数序列 $a_i$，使得上述操作恰好进行 $K$ 次。在本题的输入和输出约束下，可以证明这样的序列一定存在。

## 约束条件

- $0 ≤ K ≤ 50 \times 10^{16}$

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入中以以下格式给出：

```
K
```

## 输出格式

请按照以下格式输出一个满足条件的解：

```
N
a_1 a_2 ... a_N
```

必须满足 $2 ≤ N ≤ 50$ 且 $0 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^{16} + 1000$。

samples.note: The operation will be performed twice: [2, 2] -> [0, 3] -> [1, 1].
